text: {"lessons":["I made no trades through several sizable monthly swings, and my account ended slightly above where it began; patience suited this stretch, though it did not eliminate risk.","The rebound after declines and losses after gains reinforce that recent price moves are not reliable forecasts, so I should not chase them.","Before changing positions, I should weigh the risk carefully and follow a deliberate plan rather than let my stronger reaction to losses drive a decision."]}
